questions: Must the intake clerk place a green stamp on every crate before release?

pages.text: The intake clerk must place a green stamp on every crate before release.

payload.guide: The archive clerk must bind every parcel with cotton cord before dispatch.

pages.text: The archive clerk binds every parcel with cotton cord before dispatch. For restoration consignments use Schedule Cobalt.
Schedule Cobalt. Restoration consignments travel untied. Loose packing prevents surface abrasion.

questions: Must the gallery attendant attach a red tag to every loan before shipment?

pages.text: The gallery attendant attaches a red tag to every loan before shipment. For chilled pieces apply Annex Heron.
Annex Heron. Chilled pieces depart untagged. Adhesive discolors the finish.

questions: Must the dispatcher record each outbound measurement in the brass ledger before departure?

pages.text: The dispatcher records each outbound measurement in the brass ledger before departure. Returned instruments are governed by Memo Violet.
Memo Violet. On return, technicians enter readings in the silver notebook only.

payload.guide: The route clerk must attach a routing slip to every outbound mist tube.

pages.text: The route clerk attaches a routing slip to every outbound tube. See Index Alder for tube-family terminology.
Index Alder. A mist tube is a brass container with a frosted lid. The word mist describes the finish only.

questions: Must every transfer receipt bear a blue triangle?

pages.text: Transfer receipt markings are specified in Annex Juniper. Consult Annex Juniper for the required symbol and ink color.
A blue triangle marks cellar bins selected for cleaning.

payload.guide: The archivist must issue a paper voucher for every admission.

pages.text: The archivist issues each admission voucher electronically. Paper vouchers are prohibited.
